zh.title: 出错后可以继续输入
zh.description: 请求被限流或出错并停止后，输入框不再卡住，对话区不再闪烁

zh.title: 一次交付多个文件
zh.description: 同一轮里的图片、PDF、网页等多个成果都能正常交付并出现在成果卡里

zh.title: 图片输入开关
zh.description: 在模型设置里为每个模型单独打开或关闭图片输入，中转站的模型也能发图

en.title: Keep typing after an error
en.description: After a rate-limited or failed request is stopped, the composer stays usable and the conversation no longer flickers

en.title: Deliver several files at once
en.description: Images, PDFs, web pages and other results from the same turn are all delivered and shown as artifacts

en.title: Image input switch
en.description: Turn image input on or off per model in model settings, including models served through a gateway
